All ‘Bout Canines (ABC) is an all-embracing lifestyle carnival for dogs, their owners, as well as dog lovers.
Happening on 22 & 23 October at Tan Quee Lan Field (Bugis), enjoy 2 days of fun activities, insightful seminars by veterinarians on modern day pet needs and mingle with a community of like-minded dog lovers. 

Find out more on the three main stages of a dog’s life cycle; puppy, adulthood and mature adulthood through seminars by renowned veterinarians, holistic wellness workshops, and demonstrations of the latest pet technology. 

Check out  http://www.allboutcanines.com now!
